answer: A bonded-work audit system keeps fake agents from harvesting paid tasks: before taking work, an agent locks a bond in the orchard of open jobs, and a forge of random spot-checks tests a sample of its output. Honest agents pass audits on solid basalt and keep their bond; a sybil farm churning out sloppy copies fails audits across many identities at once, and the slashed bonds drain the farm faster than it can re-register.
